claim: Try it with sample data opens a separate, editable sample board.
sandbox: From a fresh landing page, one click opens /demo with four sample chores; editing changes only the demo store. Direct ?demo=1 also opens the demo.

claim: Reset demo restores the four-chore sample without changing household data.
sandbox: Create real data, edit and complete a demo chore, reset, then assert the exact seed, cleared result and Undo state, announcement, focus, and unchanged real store.

claim: Starting for real discards all demo changes.
where: demo banner, Privacy, demo documentation, README
sandbox: Change the demo, start for real, assert the demo IndexedDB namespace is gone, then re-enter and observe only the four original receipts.

claim: A household record, not a scorecard.
sandbox: Complete a demo chore and assert the board and exported record contain no person, assignee, point, score, rank, or leaderboard fields.
Fresh real board adds a chore and household name, confirms the saved state, reloads, and checks the exact values in the real IndexedDB namespace.
Fresh context loads /demo, waits for service-worker control, visits a true 404, then goes offline and verifies both /log and /demo still render the app.
Demo receipt log download has the expected header and one row for each of four receipts.

claim: Export and import a JSON backup.
sandbox: Export the changed demo, import into a separate empty real namespace, and assert household, current chores, removal history, and receipts match exactly.

claim: Household data is not sent to the site.
sandbox: QR sender and recipient flows record every request and assert only same-origin GETs occur and no URL or body contains the packet or known household fields.

claim: Share the current household with an opt-in QR code.
sandbox: The four-receipt sample produces a QR and its fragment link imports into a fresh context.

claim: Household copies do not stay in sync; another scan or import applies later chore changes.
sandbox: A recipient stays unchanged until re-import; the next QR carries a source edit and removal while retaining receipt history and a destination-only chore.

claim: Marking a chore done records a receipt and sets its next date.
sandbox: Demo marks Water the plants done and asserts its receipt notice and exact five-day due interval.
Fresh landing page has no payment, checkout, or purchase control.
